newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 narrowly sets record high at open.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 narrowly sets record high at open.

text.p: Leading UK blue chips narrowly scored a new record high within the first few minutes of trading on Friday, fuelled by a strong performance on Wall Street and another takeover offer in the UK financial sector, dealers said.
By 0839 GMT, the benchmark FTSE 100 was up 4.0 points to 4,331.1, the highest level ever for the index.
Firm gilts and bunds, steady T-bonds and a dip in sterling also lent support, but dealers said investors remain cautious.
"Wall Street's performance was encouraging, but nobody is getting euphoric," said one dealer.
